author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸತ್ತುಹೋದವರಾರು ಎತ್ತಹೋಹರೊ ತಿಳಿಯೆ
ಹೊತ್ತುಹೋಗುವರೇನು ಧನಕನಕ ವಸ್ತು
ಕಿತ್ತುತಿನ್ನುವ ಕೊರತೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮೆರೆಸುವ ಒರತೆ
ಸತ್ತವರ ಕಾಡಿಸದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Who knows where the dead go?
do they carry off money, gold and things?
the lack that gnaws and the spring that makes you strut
do not trouble the dead, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: No one knows where the dead go, and they take nothing with them. The wants that eat at us and the riches we show off mean nothing at the end.
